name: MECH OPS 2092
description:
About This Game

Mech Ops 2092 is a fast-paced arcade mech simulator with a third-person view, where a rough military atmosphere meets the aesthetics of 80s mecha anime: powerful war machines, heavy weapons, fearless soldiers, and lots of explosions.

Description

As an independent mercenary, you will find yourself in a near-future world that has survived an energy crisis, a series of global wars, and impact of a massive meteorite that changed Earth forever.

Old nations have nearly vanished, leaving behind only fragmented factions and greedy corporations fighting for resources and power across scorched wastelands.

Customize your mech, complete a variety of missions, fight off hordes of enemies, and take down massive bosses.

Gameplay Features

Large-scale battles
Feel yourself at the center of a real war: our advanced pathfinding and VFX management systems support up to 200 fully active combat units on screen. Dozens of tanks, helicopters, and mechs turn the battlefield into a kingdom of fire and steel.

You are not alone
You are not fighting solo — allied forces fight alongside you. They provide fire support, capture control points, and hold back enemy advances. But only you can turn the tide of battle.

High mobility
Your mech is highly agile: dash across the battlefield, perform rapid boosts, and jump to avoid danger. Constant movement is the key to survival — hesitation means death.

A walking arsenal
Your mech is equipped with 4 primary weapons, a wide range of support modules, and powerful tactical abilities called “Stratagems.” Choose your loadout wisely — a well-built setup lets you handle anything from swarms of drones to city-sized bosses.

Persistent destruction
Thanks to a dedicated instancing system, everything you destroy remains on the battlefield: wrecked enemies, collapsed buildings, fallen trees. After the fight, you can witness the full scale of the chaos you created.

Combat system
Standard enemies are easy to destroy — but there are many of them. Elite units require strategy: overload their defenses with rapid-fire weapons, then strike weak points with precision. Engage in close combat or use mines — the choice is yours, but act fast.

Massive bosses
Colossal walking fortresses are more than enemies — they are full-scale missions. Find weak points, destroy mounted weapons, attack cooling systems and hangars. Sometimes, you’ll need to get inside and destroy the reactor from within.

Dynamic environment
Your mech gets dirty, worn, wet, and covered in dust and battle damage.

Hangar

Build your unique mech
Over 30 weapon types, multiple variations of heads, bodies, arms, and legs, as well as modules and stratagems — everything you need to create a build for any situation.

Weapon modification
Fragmentation or armor-piercing shells? Cluster or thermobaric missles? Extended magazines or homing projectiles? Modify weapon behavior to suit your playstyle — no “+1% crit chance,” only meaningful changes.

Mechanics over stats
Each mech part provides unique abilities: thermal vision, hover legs, coaxial weapons, additional module slots. Changing parts means changing gameplay.

Customization
Choose colors for each mech part and apply decals. Military camo or glossy red finish? Create your own style.

Stratagems

Stratagems are powerful tactical abilities that complement your mech’s weapons. They have long cooldowns but can turn the tide of battle.

Supply drops, reinforcements, missile strikes, turrets, remote mines — each stratagem shines in the right situation.

Game Modes

Campaign Mode

You are a war veteran. After being betrayed by your employer, you are left without money or reputation. All you have is your mech.

Now you must rise from nothing, find a new home, uncover the secrets of powerful corporations, shape the fate of the world — and survive.

Reputation system
Complete faction missions, build relationships, and unlock unique gear.

Non-linear story
Your actions influence the balance of power and determine the ending. You decide who will dominate — and who will disappear forever.

Mobile base
A transport ship becomes your home: hangar, living quarters, command center — everything needed to run your own private military company. But first, you must take it by force.

Missions

A wide variety of objectives: sabotage, defense, counter-battles, anti-air missions, base assaults, and caravan raids.

Battles across the world
Ruined cities, snowy mountains, swampy jungles, the deserts of the Sahara, tropical islands, and ash-covered wastelands.

Battlefield conditions
Night requires thermal vision, radiation storms disrupt radar, heat causes weapons to overheat, swamps slow movement. Adapt your build to each mission.

Negotiations with employers
Bargain for better rewards using your reputation. Choose between money or barter — higher risk means higher reward.

Intel inaccuracies
Mission data may be wrong — or you may be deliberately misled.

Moral choices
You can leave a mission at any time. Refuse contracts that go against your values — but remember, every choice has consequences.

Operation system
Chains of missions that impact the final battle. Resources and repairs are limited — plan your strategy carefully.

Defense Mode

Fight in a simulation against endless waves of enemies, refine your build, and push your combat skills to perfection.
short_desc: Customize your battle mech, pick contracts, and choose which side to fight for. Large-scale battles, deep customization, nonlinear storyline.
